booking_org_contact_single_active_uq.name: booking_org_contact_single_active_uq
booking_org_contact_single_active_uq.where: "booking"."status" in ('agendada','realizada') and "booking"."is_test" = false and "booking"."additional_confirmed" = false and "booking"."contact_id" is not null

client_asset_secret_ck.name: client_asset_secret_ck
client_asset_secret_ck.value: ("client_asset"."secret_cipher" IS NULL AND "client_asset"."secret_iv" IS NULL AND "client_asset"."secret_tag" IS NULL) OR ("client_asset"."secret_cipher" IS NOT NULL AND "client_asset"."secret_iv" IS NOT NULL AND "client_asset"."secret_tag" IS NOT NULL)

lse_loss_reason_ck.name: lse_loss_reason_ck
lse_loss_reason_ck.value: "lead_stage_event"."to_stage_kind" <> 'lost' OR "lead_stage_event"."approximate" = true OR "lead_stage_event"."loss_reason" IS NOT NULL
